description: Establish a verifiable baseline for this no-build PHP+JS project so later features can be checked without a live DB. There is no build/test infra, so this feature only confirms the syntax-check tooling works and records the current chart/config facts that later features depend on. Independent of all other features (must run first only because it validates the tooling used by every later verification step).
steps: Confirm PHP CLI is available and lints cleanly: run `for f in api/*.php *.php; do php -l "$f"; done` from the repo root (/projects/sandbox/arvcoin) and confirm every file reports 'No syntax errors detected'. Record any pre-existing failures verbatim in this feature's findings.

Confirm node can parse the frontend modules: run `for f in js/*.js js/pages/*.js arv-config.js; do node --check "$f"; done` and record results. Note in findings that node --check validates syntax only and does not resolve ES imports.

Confirm arv-config.js loads as an object: run `node -e "globalThis.window={};require('./arv-config.js');var c=globalThis.ARV_CONFIG;console.log('base',c.INDEX.arvBaseInr,'launch',c.INDEX.launchIso,'defaultTf',c.CHARTS.defaultTimeframe,'ranges',JSON.stringify(c.CHARTS.ranges),'backfill',JSON.stringify(c.CHARTS.backfill))"` and record the printed current values in findings (these are the before-state that FEAT-003 and FEAT-004 change).

Do NOT install MySQL or attempt to run install.php, cron.php, or any DB-backed endpoint. Record in findings that runtime verification is impossible in this sandbox (no MySQL, no mail) and must be deferred to a live environment.
acceptance_criteria: Every existing api/*.php and root *.php file passes `php -l` with 'No syntax errors detected' (or any pre-existing failure is documented in findings).
Every js/*.js and js/pages/*.js and arv-config.js passes `node --check`.
arv-config.js loads via node and prints its current INDEX/CHARTS values, which are recorded in findings as the baseline.
verification: Run `for f in api/*.php *.php; do php -l "$f"; done` and confirm no unexpected syntax errors.
Run `for f in js/*.js js/pages/*.js arv-config.js; do node --check "$f"; done` and confirm no parse errors.

findings.php_lint: PASS. Ran `for f in api/*.php *.php; do php -l "$f"; done` with PHP 8.4 CLI from repo root. All 17 files reported 'No syntax errors detected': api/account.php, api/admin.php, api/auth.php, api/_boot.php, api/cron.php, api/deposit.php, api/_feed.php, api/_google.php, api/kyc.php, api/market.php, api/_match.php, api/_money.php, api/orders.php, api/referral.php, api/_schema.php, api/withdraw.php, install.php. No pre-existing failures. (Note: root globs `*.php` matched only install.php; the other root files are .html/.js.)
findings.node_check: PASS for all frontend modules. Ran `node --check` on js/*.js (api, feed, qr, reveal, ui), js/pages/*.js (admin, auth, dashboard, deposit, home, legal, profile, referral, tax, trade, transactions, withdraw), and arv-config.js. All parsed with no syntax errors. node --check validates syntax only and does NOT resolve ES imports, so import graph correctness is not covered by this check.
findings.node_env_workaround: The sandbox sets NODE_OPTIONS='--require /opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js', but that bootstrap file does not exist, so a bare `node` invocation aborts with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before running. Workaround used for all node commands: prefix with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS`. Later features running node must do the same (e.g. `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check <file>`).

arv_config_baseline.note: Current before-state values loaded via `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node -e "globalThis.window={};require('./arv-config.js');..."`. These are the values FEAT-003/FEAT-004 are expected to change; compare against these.

findings.runtime_verification: IMPOSSIBLE in this sandbox. No MySQL server and no mail server are available, so install.php, cron.php, DB migrations, price ingest/backfill, order matching, and any DB-backed endpoint cannot be executed. Per instructions, none were run. All runtime/DB/exchange-API behaviour must be deferred to a live environment and verified there.
findings.code_changes: None. This is a baseline/tooling-validation chore; no source files were modified. Only this feature's task-state file was updated.
